title: 第十四章 年关将近

content_zh:
赫连琪坐在一把雕花木椅上，手里捏着一个茶杯，也不喝，只是无意识地用手指死命地抠着杯子沿，眼睛直直地盯着地面。
李道人坐在一边，不动也不出声，干瘦的身躯就像段快要枯死的木头，乍一看，都注意不到他的存在。
突然，赫连琪猛地把手里的茶杯摔倒地上，滚烫的水溅得到处都是，门口候着的一个小丫头闻声立刻进来，慌慌张张地俯身就用手去拾，赫连琪却一声断喝道：“狗奴才，谁让你进来的，滚！”
小丫头被他吓了一跳，青葱似的指头尖叫碎瓷片划出一道血痕，不敢声张，连忙弓着身退出去了。
从头到尾，李道人都入定了似的不言不动，溅出来的茶水沾到了他的靴子上，他也不甚在意，连脚都未曾缩回去。
赫连琪却坐不住了，拍案站起来，在屋里来回踱步：“不过是个蛮子……不过是个偷汉子生出来的小杂种！仗着老头子给的几分颜色，竟要爬到我头上来了！”他用手使劲一拍旁边的小木桌，又觉得不解恨，长臂一扫，把桌上盆景茶具全都扫到地上，碎成一摊。
赫连琪双手撑在桌子上喘着粗气：“不弄死他，不弄死他……我赫连琪名字要倒过来写！”
李道人这才慢吞吞地开口，他的嗓音极其喑哑，像是生锈的铁片在里面划来划去似的：“二殿下稍安勿躁，我瞧着，那南疆巫童不过是碰巧和太子走到一路罢了，不见得有什么关联。”
“太子？”赫连琪在一边坐下，冷笑一声，好像这名字念出来便污了他的口似的，“赫连翊不过是个毛还没长全的小崽子，算哪门子太子？”
李道人点头道：“这便是了，二殿下乃是要做大事的人，将来有收拾他们的时候，何苦现在和他们一般计较？眼下最要紧的是老大那头，那赫连钊狼子野心，一门心思在军中安插眼线，一帮粗人本不足为虑，可若听之任之，万一他将来羽翼丰满，闹出逼宫之事，可不好收场。”
赫连琪重重地哼了一声。
只听李道人又道：“只是有一点，赫连翊毕竟是皇上亲封的太子，将来就算二殿下得势，怕也要费上一番功夫，方可名正言顺。”
赫连琪冷笑道：“他那么个见了宫中阉人都点头示好的懦弱性子，可有一分半分太子的架子？父皇养的八哥都比他金贵些。”
李道人摩挲着自己稀疏的胡子，摇头道：“虽不足为虑，也不可小瞧，二殿下还要留心些景北渊，那南宁王虽深居浅出，却能深受帝宠这些年……”他微微顿了顿，两条扫帚眉皱起来，“贫道老觉得他有些个古怪之处，十来岁的一个孩子，又没有父母兄弟约束，竟能耐得住寂寞这些年，若不是过了年便要临朝听证，说不准还不会出王府的门……总有些不寻常。”
赫连琪轻慢道：“连赫连翊都明白他是个好吃懒做的绣花枕头，道长何必多虑？”
李道长放下茶杯：“这倒是未必，恐怕太子殿下心里，这位景王爷多少有些不一般。”
赫连琪顿了顿，想起了什么似的，脸上露出些许猥/亵之色：“这倒是，那景北渊人虽不成器，长得却是一日赛一日的俊俏，赫连翊三天两头往他那里走动，安的什么心思……嘿！”
李道人道：“那太子殿下，多年来一直勤俭克身，沽了那么个严于待己宽于待人的名儿，只怕方才情窦初开，不见得真明白自己的心意。”
赫连琪细眉一挑，问道：“怎么说？”
李道人只高深莫测地一笑道：“还需再观察观察……话说今日我见了那南宁王，竟想起一人来，是当初落魄时候接济过贫道的一家人，有个女孩儿名叫翠儿，今年方才十七岁，后来赶上疫病，父母都得病死了，她一个人沿街乞讨，叫班子老板看上了，教养起来，几年间还唱出了点名气，前段时间进了京，听见人说，便来投奔贫道，念着他家恩情，贫道便收她做了个干女儿。”

赫连琪愣了愣，没听懂他的意思。
李道人道：“如今想起来，那翠儿眉目间，竟颇有些像南宁王爷，也巧了。”
赫连琪沉吟了一会，笑道：“改日我倒要见见了。”
李道人笑而不语。
正这会，门口有人来报，说是赵大人家人前来，给二殿下送年货。赫连琪思路被打断，有些不高兴，便粗声粗气地问道：“哪个赵大人？”

content_en:
Helianqi was sitting on a carved wooden chair, holding a tea cup in his hand. He didn't drink, but unconsciously dug at the rim of the cup with his fingers, staring straight at the ground.
Li Daoren sat aside, motionless and silent. His thin body was like a piece of wood that was about to die. At first glance, one could not even notice his presence.
Suddenly, Helianqi slammed the tea cup in his hand to the ground, and the hot water splashed everywhere. A little girl waiting at the door came in immediately after hearing the sound, and leaned over to pick it up in a panic. However, Helianqi shouted: "You dog slave, who let you in, get out!"
The little girl was startled by him. She screamed with her green fingers and broke the porcelain pieces, leaving a bloody mark. She didn't dare to say anything and hurriedly bowed her body and exited.
From the beginning to the end, Taoist Li seemed to be in trance and remained motionless. He didn't care much when the spilled tea got on his boots, and he didn't even retract his feet.
But Helianqi couldn't sit still anymore. He stood up from the table and paced back and forth in the room: "He's just a barbarian...just a little bastard born of a thieves! With some color given by the old man, he's actually trying to climb on top of me!" He slapped the small wooden table next to him hard with his hand. Feeling uneasy, he swept all the bonsai tea sets on the table to the ground with a long arm and broke them into a pile.
Helianqi put his hands on the table and gasped: "If you don't kill him, don't kill him... My name, Helianqi, will be written upside down!"
Only then did Taoist Li speak slowly. His voice was extremely hoarse, as if rusty iron pieces were scratching inside: "Second Highness, please be patient. I see that the Southern Xinjiang shaman just happened to be with the prince. There may not be any connection."
"Prince?" He Lianqi sat down on the side and sneered, as if just saying the name would taint his mouth, "He Lianyi is just a little brat whose hair has not yet fully grown, so what kind of prince is he?"
Li Daoren nodded and said: "That's it. Your Highness is the person who wants to do big things. If you have to deal with them in the future, why bother with them now? The most important thing right now is the boss. He Lianzhao is ambitious and only wants to plant spies in the army. A bunch of rough guys are nothing to worry about. But if you let him go unchecked, it will not end well if he becomes full-fledged in the future and causes trouble to force the palace."
Helianqi snorted heavily.
Daoren Li then said, "There's just one thing. After all, He Lian Yi is the crown prince personally appointed by the emperor. Even if His Highness gains power in the future, I'm afraid it will take a lot of effort before he can be justified."
Helianqi sneered: "He is such a coward who nods to show his kindness to the eunuchs in the palace, but does he have the airs of a prince? Even the mynas raised by my father are more valuable than him."
Li Daoren stroked his sparse beard, shook his head and said: "Although it is not a cause for concern, it should not be underestimated. Your Highness should pay more attention to Jing Beiyuan. Although King Nanning lives in a simple way, he has been favored by the emperor over the years..." He paused slightly and frowned. , "The poor Taoist thinks there is something strange about him. A child of ten years old, without the restraints of his parents and brothers, can endure loneliness for these years. If he had not had to go to court for a hearing after the New Year, he might not have left the palace... It is always a bit unusual."
He Lianqi said scornfully: "Even He Lianyi knows that he is a lazy embroidered pillow, why should Taoist priest worry too much?"
Daochang Li put down his teacup: "That's not necessarily true. I'm afraid that in His Highness's mind, this Prince Jing is somewhat unusual."
Helianqi paused, as if remembering something, with a slightly obscene look on his face: "It's true, although the Jingbeiyuan man is not good at anything, he is more handsome every day. Helianyi walks to him every two days, what's the point of An... Hey!"
Li Daoren said: "Your Highness, the Crown Prince, has been diligent and thrifty for many years, and has gained a reputation of being strict with himself and lenient with others. I'm afraid he has just begun to have a love interest.Seeing that I really understand my own thoughts. "
Helianqi raised her slender eyebrows and asked, "How do you say that? "
Li Daoren only smiled enigmatically and said: "We still need to observe more... Speaking of which, when I met the King of Nanning today, I remembered someone. It was a family that helped poor Dao when he was in poverty. There was a girl named Cui'er. She was only seventeen years old this year. Later, she caught up with the epidemic. Her parents died of illness, so she begged alone on the street, and the team boss took a fancy to her. After being educated, she became somewhat famous in singing in a few years. She went to Beijing some time ago, and when she heard people say, she came to Pindao, and out of gratitude for his family's kindness, Pindao took her in as a goddaughter. "
Helianqi was stunned, not understanding what he meant.
Li Daoren said: "Now that I think about it, it's a coincidence that Cui'er's eyebrows look a bit like the Prince of Nanning. "
Helianqi pondered for a while and then said with a smile: "I will meet you some other time. "
Li Daoren smiled and said nothing.
At this moment, someone came to the door to report that Mr. Zhao's family was here to deliver New Year's gifts to His Highness. Helianqi's thoughts were interrupted and she was a little unhappy, so she asked in a rough voice: "Which Mr. Zhao? "
